subject.title: Dashboard: inter-widget pub/sub — a tab-scoped message bus

question: Should OpenClaw accept tab-scoped inter-widget pub/sub as part of the bundled modular dashboard bridge after the Wave 1 dashboard stack is accepted?
rationale: This adds a new widget-to-widget communication capability over a security-sensitive bridge whose base dashboard implementation is still open and not yet accepted on main.

options.title: Sponsor After Wave 1 Lands
options.body: Review and land or reject the backend, Workspaces UI, and custom-widget stack first, then accept pub/sub only with explicit isolation and lifecycle tests.

options.title: Fold Into Bridge Design Review
options.body: Ask the dashboard stack author to include pub/sub in the custom-widget bridge security review before the bridge lands.

options.title: Defer The Apps Layer
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but do not implement it until the bundled dashboard direction has stronger product and security sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Wave 1 Lands
recommendation.body: Review and land or reject the backend, Workspaces UI, and custom-widget stack first, then accept pub/sub only with explicit isolation and lifecycle tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and likely product/security review boundary this feature would extend.
